journal_lines: §oSmelled it before finding it — old rope, iron, human hands long gone. §lPoacher's blind§o in the crook of an elm.
§aBlind built into the tree line on a deer path. Snares set, none sprung. Carried the snares home.
Hunter read the setup. Woodcutter identified the timber it was built from. Between us, we stripped it clean.
§aAbandoned in a hurry — gear left, fire cold for a season at least. Good find for two that knew what to look for.
The blinds they build are useful things. Rope, iron fittings, a good view of a game trail. Took all three.
Whoever used it had not been back recently. The wasps had moved in. Cleared the wasps, took the iron.
§aHunter spotted the shooting lane. Woodcutter spotted the structural timber. Both came home with something.
No one coming back for it. The forest already working on reclaiming it. We got there first.
